code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    coords=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,1)]
    color=g[coords[0][0]][coords[0][1]]
    r0=min(i for i,j in coords); c0=min(j for i,j in coords)
    shape={(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in coords}
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==0 for i,j in cells):
                for i,j in cells: g[i][j]=color
    return g
'''
